notes: How this part was researched: the session's shared web-search allowance was already used up, so no search was run. Pages were opened directly with the kit's honest User-Agent (robots.txt read first for each host) or with the page-reading tool: the twelve campaign websites the candidates filed (read from sl_websites in the database, read-only), each county's, city's and school district's own site, and the Minnesota DFL's list of endorsed candidates.

Official pages read that do NOT list the candidate as holding the office sought today: Pine County (District 2: Joshua Mohr), Murray County (District 3: Dennis Welgraven), Polk County (4th District: Joan Lee), Albert Lea (Mayor: Rich Murray), the Cambridge council, the Hutchinson council (Seat 2) and Hutchinson school board, and the White Bear Lake, Elk River (District 2: Sara Weis), Kasson-Mantorville and St. Cloud school boards. So no office is recorded for Denise Weis, Tyson VanPeursem, Michael (Mike) Wedin, Tiffany Fearing, Tom Schibilla, Aaron French, Lisa Rasmussen, Colleen Berquist, Shari Knip, Albert J. Brand or Sonia Eizenhoefer.

Not read, and nothing worked around: the Minnesota Judicial Branch's site (403 to the page-reading tool), so nothing is recorded for Patrick Rohland; Fergus Falls's Elected Officials page (the roster loads by script), so nothing for Scott Kvamme; Cloquet Public Schools' site (no board page could be reached), so nothing for Elizabeth Kersting-Peterson; the City of Ramsey's site did not answer the script.

No Republican endorsement could be recorded for Michael Kreun, Bidal Duran Jr or Sara Bertschinger: without a search, no party unit's page naming them was found. Sara Bertschinger's own site calls her the endorsed Republican candidate; that is recorded as her own words only.

Brian McCoy's own Endorsements page lists "DFL47 Minnesota Senate District" among the organizations supporting him; no page of that party unit was found, so it is recorded as his own words only, not under endorsed_by. His two county appointments rest on his campaign site; Washington County's own page for them was not found.
Luke Sweere's site describes posts in the Frazee Police Department and the Becker County Sheriff's Office; those are employment, not offices, and are not recorded.

The Mounds View City Council Directory, cited as Zach Lindstrom's official page, is the city's own page and also prints council members' contact details; only his name, title and term end were taken. No birth year was found for anyone.
Sitting legislators (Kreun, Duran, Vang, Pursell): only the website, endorsements and own words were looked for.

Verifier, 2026-10-02: every url re-opened (several needed a second try because of lost address lookups). All 29 findings confirmed. Corrected: Marshall County's page has moved to marshallcountymn.gov (the old address forwards there); the wording of how three websites were recognised (Bertschinger, Eizenhoefer, Brand). Nothing removed. The DFL list names Amanda Hemmingsen-Jaeger for Senate District 47 and does not name Brian McCoy, so his DFL47 line stays his own words only.
